_comment: Edit this file to tweak which keywords the discovery agent searches. Each one becomes a separate FB groups search. Add or remove freely.

thresholds._min_members_comment: Minimum member count to keep in results. Set to 0 to keep everything for inspection.
thresholds._very_active_bonus_comment: Score boost for groups FB tags as 'Very active'. Bumps a 60K-member-very-active above a 100K-member-quiet group.

_scroll_passes_comment: How many End-key presses per search. More = more results loaded but slower.
_throttle_ms_comment: [min, max] random pause between actions in milliseconds. Slower = more human-like, less detection risk.
